mapper.insert: INSERT INTO point_transaction (user_id, type, change_amount, balance_after, remain_amount, expire_time, batch_tx_id, description, ref_id, create_time, update_time, deleted) VALUES (#{userId}, #{type}, #{changeAmount}, #{balanceAfter}, #{remainAmount}, #{expireTime}, #{batchTxId}, #{description}, #{refId}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime}, #{deleted})
mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, type, change_amount, balance_after, remain_amount, expire_time, batch_tx_id, description, ref_id, create_time, update_time, deleted FROM point_transaction WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND deleted = 0 ORDER BY create_time DESC

SELECT id, user_id, type, change_amount, balance_after, remain_amount, expire_time, batch_tx_id, description, ref_id, create_time, update_time FROM point_transaction WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND deleted = 0 AND remain_amount > 0 AND (expire_time IS NULL OR expire_time > NOW()) ORDER BY create_time ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE point_transaction SET remain_amount = remain_amount - #{amount}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND remain_amount >= #{amount}
UPDATE point_transaction SET remain_amount = remain_amount + #{amount}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE point_transaction SET deleted = 1 WHERE id = #{id}
